name: CloudMoon
requires: Nothing: CloudMoon's free play time, as a guest
pitch: Mobile games from the cloud, on your PS3.
description: Browse and search the mobile games CloudMoon streams from cloud Android phones (Roblox, Genshin Impact and more), with CloudMoon's free play time as a guest. Playing them on the PS3 comes in an update. Not made by or affiliated with CloudMoon.
whatsNew: Unlink on the Account tab starts a new guest (it did nothing). Signing in with your own CloudMoon account, and playing, come in an update.
